planets.name: K2-17 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-17 with a 18-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: K2-17 b was found in 2015 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-17. Its orbit and size follow Montet et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
